<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex040012026-09-0201-22-58" status="unreviewed"> <quote><l>nyid mtshan ring spung gi rgyu <expan>mtshan ni</expan> ||</l> <l>nyi ma lho byang 'gro tshe so</l></quote> zhes pa ste | 
            <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4243">'ban</rs> na re dzaM bu kling sogs kar gnas pa'i dam gi sde ltar ring thung du 'gyur ste | mar po'i 'do'i char ba bzhin no zhes <expan>zer ro</expan> ||
         <pb n="310"/>
            <lb edRef="inst:4749" n="155b1"/> de la <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4261">'chims</rs> na re de lta nas dzaM bu kling kho na na ri spung yod par 'gyur gyi gling gzhan na ring spung <expan>med</expan> par 'gyur bas mi rigs so zhes <expan>zer ro</expan> || </seg></TEI>
